verdict.rationale: Superhuman is an email client, so open-protocol access and standards-based export are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence only shows that it works on top of Gmail and Outlook accounts. Nothing documents IMAP, JMAP or SMTP support, or an export to standard formats such as mbox or EML. Any openness comes from the host mail providers, not Superhuman itself, and the MCP connector to AI assistants is an adjacent feature, not open mail-protocol access.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
